## PR 407

**Customer invoice (named in the register round-15 scope)**

**বাংলায়:** কাস্টমারের ইনভয়েস: প্রতিটা অর্ডারের ইনভয়েস একবার তৈরি হয়ে থাকে, একটা নম্বর সারাজীবন; অর্ডার বদলালে একই নম্বরে "সংশোধিত"; অর্ডার → প্যাকিং আর প্রিন্ট → ইনভয়েস থেকে কাগজে, থার্মাল রোলে বা চ্যাটের ছবিতে; শুধু অর্ডারে যা আছে তাই দেখায়

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-10-30
  - Build status row: the customer invoice issued once per order and kept (migration `0050_invoice_support` additive: `GeneratedDocument` number, fingerprint, data, checked time; settings registry v63 `registry-invoice.ts`, group `orders`): one number per order for life, a new version with the same number ("Revised n") only when the order's content changes (lines, money, names, address) — payments, confirms and status steps never make one; the worker job `invoices.issue` (on, every 10 minutes, 200 a run, 30 days back) issues new and edited orders, an older order gets its invoice when opened or printed; the invoice shows only what the order holds (no price or total is worked out again, CN-022). Orders → Packing & print → Invoices (`/admin/orders/packing/invoices`): counts, views all / revised / waiting, search, one PDF of many on paper (A4/A5) or the thermal roll (80/58 mm), per order paper, roll or the chat picture (JPG); letterhead and column names on every page, a row never split, the courier's consignment barcode. `documents.invoice.print` (A4, roll 80 mm, 203 dpi, en, barcode on, logo on, 100 per print), `documents.invoice.image` (JPG, 1240 px, quality 85), `documents.invoice.issue`; with `account.invoice` as cards on the page. New permission `orders.invoiceSettings`; the customer's invoice shows the issued number, "Revised n" and the barcode
  - GitHub pull request #54, 30 Oct
- **What it does:** Customer invoice (named in the register round-15 scope) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1624) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **Updates and change notes, in date order:**
  - **19 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (round 15, no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-624): **Invoice (PR 407 customer invoice + the invoice templates in S20)** — every word and block of the invoice editable from the dashboard (owner, 19 Oct).
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `registry-invoice.ts`
  - Routes: `/admin/orders/packing/invoices`
  - Settings and named keys: `invoices.issue`, `documents.invoice.print`, `documents.invoice.image`, `documents.invoice.issue`, `account.invoice`, `orders.invoiceSettings`
  - Names in the code: `0050_invoice_support`, `GeneratedDocument`, `orders`
- **Owning agent:** Bhandari
